options.command: VITE_API_BASE_URL=$(terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform output -raw api_endpoint) pnpm --filter @crossword-solver/ui build && aws s3 sync packages/ui/dist s3://$(terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform output -raw ui_bucket_name) --delete --exclude index.html --cache-control 'public,max-age=31536000,immutable' && aws s3 cp packages/ui/dist/index.html s3://$(terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform output -raw ui_bucket_name)/index.html --cache-control 'no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate' --content-type 'text/html' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform output -raw ui_cloudfront_distribution_id) --paths '/*'
